data.title: The photo that sums up Europe’s wildfire summer
data.description: PARIS - AFP photo editor Maximilien Lamy was on holiday with his partner and daughter last week when he took a series of snapshots of vacationers in fire-struck southwestern France with his smartphone.

data.title: US Senate confirms Clayton as Trump intelligence chief
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The US Senate has confirmed Jay Clayton as President Donald Trump's top intelligence official, putting a permanent chief in charge of the country's spy agencies as the president revives unsupported election fraud claims ahead of the midterms.

data.title: US and Saudis strike Iraq militants in expanding war
data.description: BAGHDAD - US and Saudi forces said they struck an Iraqi militant alliance on Wednesday, as the Middle East war expands beyond its main focus in Iran to involve the Islamic republic’s proxies.

data.title: Spanish wildfire evacuees start returning home
data.description: ALDEA DEL FRESNO, Spain - Thousands of Spaniards evacuated from the path of huge wildfires were returning home on Wednesday while in France firefighters braced for worsening conditions in their own battle with raging flames.

data.title: Hong Kong bookstores closing after ‘sedition’ raids
data.description: HONG KONG - A Hong Kong bookshop raided by national security police earlier this month announced on Wednesday that it would close after 50 years in business, while another has shut down ahead of schedule.

data.title: US, Saudi forces strike Iran-backed groups in Iraq
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US and Saudi Arabian forces said they struck Iran-backed militants in Iraq on Wednesday in retaliation for recent attacks, following a short pause in Iran war hostilities.

data.title: Japan coral protectors race to save reefs from heat 'bomb'
data.description: ONNA (JAPAN) - From "heatwave simulators" to ecological bootcamps, scientists and conservationists are trying ways to revive and reinforce the famous coral reefs off Japan's Okinawa, decimated by climate-driven bleaching two summers ago.

data.title: Zelensky hails 'good' Trump talks on Patriot air defenses
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky sought licenses to produce Patriot air-defense interceptors during a "good meeting" with US counterpart Donald Trump on Tuesday, as he underscored Russia's Vladimir Putin's loss of initiative on the war front due to heavy losses.

data.title: Five dead after powerful Japan quake, others missing
data.description: KUMAMOTO (JAPAN) - A major quake that badly damaged a shopping mall and a factory in Japan killed at least five people, emergency services said on Wednesday.

data.title: Shinkansen bullet trains remain halted after M7.1 quake hits Kumamoto
data.description: Services on the Kyushu Shinkansen bullet train line will remain halted Wednesday, its operator said, a day after an earthquake with a magnitude of 7.1 struck the southwestern Japan prefecture of Kumamoto.

data.title: Netanyahu holds first White House talks with Trump since Iran war began
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu visited the White House Tuesday for his first in-person talks with President Donald Trump since the Iran war began, as the US military reported it had intercepted multiple missiles launched by Tehran.

data.title: US government bans humanoid robots manufactured abroad
data.description: NEW YORK - US President Donald Trump's administration on Tuesday added humanoid and quadruped robots to a list of products and companies that are banned from being imported into the United States on national security grounds.

data.title: Airbus completes record 24-hour flight with plane to be used by Qantas
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - A specially modified Airbus A350 plane touched down in France Tuesday after a record 24-hour test flight from Australia, ahead of it joining Qantas's fleet next year.

data.title: 2 dead at quake-hit Kumamoto Pref. shopping mall after blast
data.description: Two women were confirmed dead and one woman was found unresponsive, local authorities said Wednesday, hours after an explosion rocked a shopping mall on Japan's southwestern main island of Kyushu following a powerful magnitude-7.1 earthquake.

data.title: Dozens feared trapped in quake-hit Japan mall
data.description: TOKYO - Dozens of people were feared trapped in a shopping mall in Japan on Tuesday after a major earthquake toppled buildings, sparked fires and reportedly killed one person and injured more than 100.

data.title: Malaysia busts scam centres in Forest City
data.description: KUALA ​LUMPUR - Malaysian police have raided 32 premises hosting online ​scam activities in Forest ‌City in the state of Johor, arresting 335 people and seizing assets worth about 1 million ringgit ($245,000), the state police chief said on Tuesday.

data.title: Firefighters on the offensive in France and Spain
data.description: LEGE-CAP-FERRET, France - Firefighters in France and Spain rushed to contain the worst wildfires in living memory on Tuesday, seizing crucial hours before the arrival of another wave brings scorching temperatures.

data.title: 7.1 earthquake strikes Japan’s Kyushu region
data.description: TOKYO - An earthquake with a ​preliminary magnitude of 7.1 struck Kumamoto prefecture in southern Japan on Tuesday, knocking out power to thousands of homes, stopping rail services and triggering warnings for tsunamis and aftershocks.

data.title: Civilian killings on the rise in Myanmar
data.description: Myanmar’s military has sharply escalated attacks on civilians since a new administration took office in the war-torn country, a conflict monitor said on Monday, even as regional governments ramp up diplomatic engagement.

data.title: Wildlife face ‘catastrophic’ losses in French blazes
data.description: PARIS - Deer trapped by walls of flame, lizards unable to escape the heat, habitats reduced to charred wood and ash: wildlife are paying a steep price as France's forests burn.
